items.title: Russia's Vladimir Putin suggests no Ukraine compromise in meeting with US envoys
items.description: Russia's President Vladimir Putin indicated on Thursday, November 12, that the Kremlin would not compromise on its hardline demands to end the war in Ukraine, but offered a short-term ceasefire in a key frontline city during a meeting with US envoys. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle has more.

items.title: What Happened At The Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks? Not Much.
items.description: The White House envoys fly to Moscow for meetings with Putin a day after two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi wrapped up. Russia's lead negotiator repeated hard-line demands focusing not just on Moscow's war on Ukraine but the entire European political structure in place since World War II. Here's what you need to know

items.title: Haiti: More than 1,000 killed between July and September, UN report reveals
items.description: More than 1,000 people were killed in Haiti during the third quarter of this year, as armed gangs continue to terrorize the population in the capital Port-au-Prince and beyond, the UN team in the island nation, said in its latest human rights report.

items.title: Israel strikes Gaza hospital, says Hamas senior figure inside
items.description: Israel says Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center, while Palestinian officials report at least six people killed, including a surgeon. The strike comes amid an increasingly fragile ceasefire.

items.title: Mélenchon accuses media of 'distorting' his words after criticism of Ukraine remarks
items.description: The radical-left presidential candidate had said a referendum should be held over who controls the Russian-occupied Donbas region as a solution to the war in Ukraine, drawing rebukes even from the Ukrainian government.

items.title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, health authorities say
items.description: The victims included a surgeon, and dozens more were injured. Israel said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants.

items.title: Expectations low as US gives Ukraine peace talks another try
items.description: Although a new round of U.S.-led talks are getting underway to end the war in Ukraine, observers say that prospects for resolution remain unlikely.
